text: 商务部新闻发言人就涉及欧盟的进口对位芳纶长丝和乙叉降冰片烯两起反倾销调查答记者问。 有记者问：我们关注到商务部今日对涉及欧盟的进口对位芳纶长丝和乙叉降冰片烯发起两起反倾销调查，能否介绍相关情况？ 答：相关调查均应国内产业申请发起。申请人提供的初步证据显示，2023年至2026年上半年，自欧进口对位芳纶长丝产品的数量处于高位，价格累计跌幅超50%。自欧盟等地区进口的乙叉降冰片烯数量2023年至2025年累计增长27.35%，2026年上半年同比增长56%，且价格整体呈下降趋势。申请人主张，相关倾销进口产品对中国国内产业生产经营造成了损害。
text_en: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce answered questions on two anti-dumping investigations involving imports from the EU of para-aramid filament and ethylidene norbornene. A reporter asked: We noted that the Ministry of Commerce today initiated two anti-dumping investigations into imports from the EU of para-aramid filament and ethylidene norbornene. Could you brief us on the relevant situation? Answer: Both investigations were initiated upon applications from the domestic industry. Preliminary evidence provided by the applicants shows that from 2023 to the first half of 2026, the volume of imported para-aramid filament products from the EU remained at a high level, with prices falling by more than 50% cumulatively. Imports of ethylidene norbornene from the EU and other regions grew by 27.35% cumulatively from 2023 to 2025 and by 56% year on year in the first half of 2026, with prices generally trending downward. The applicants claim that the dumped imported products have caused harm to the production and operations of China's domestic industry.
